result.rationale: The source explicitly declares 'This requirement uses RFC 2119 and RFC 8174.' Candidate A drops that declaration entirely, losing fidelity to the source. Candidate B preserves it verbatim. Both candidates correctly preserve SHOULD NOT, keep the copy behavior descriptive (non-normative), and maintain the typed relations. The RFC declaration line is part of the rewritten requirement and its omission in A is a meaningful loss of content, giving B the material advantage.
